usage.outputShape: body.content (assistant text); body.model (resolved model id); body.usage.* (token + cost accounting)
quirks: Response is a flat object with the assistant reply at body.content (not the OpenAI choices[] shape).
Returns extensive body.usage accounting incl. reasoning_tokens; this model emits reasoning tokens (311 of 325 completion tokens were reasoning for a trivial 'hello').
usage.guide: Send a POST with a standard chat body {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}; x402 payment is handled automatically (USDC on Base, ~$0.006/call for a short prompt). Read the assistant's reply from body.content. Token/cost accounting is in body.usage; the resolved model id is in body.model. This is a plain synchronous call with no async polling or auth handshake.
